question: p-solar
unit: lump sum for whole 30 kWp array (NZD, GST excl., Auckland)

band.unit: lump sum for whole 30 kWp array (NZD, GST excl., Auckland)
band.basis: Sum of cited QV rows (purlins, bolts, roofer labour rate) plus fetched NZ vendor hardware prices (GridFree, Lusty & Blundell) and a fetched published structural-engineer report fee range, with two labelled minor allowances (sundries/fixings). Split so a reviewer can reject one part: mounting system $9,759-$17,806; strengthening $2,335-$5,344; design/PS1 $1,500-$3,500. QV has no solar mounting rows, so the mounting system rests on vendor catalogue prices plus assumed quantities and a stated labour allowance - hence low confidence and a wide band. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, PV/inverter/cabling, roof sheet work, scaffolding/edge protection and consent fees as instructed. Vendor prices may be GST-inclusive, so the band is conservative on the high side.

band.unit: lump sum, whole 30 kWp / ~60-panel array, GST exclusive
band.basis: Sum of six distinct components: mounting hardware (web proxy, scaled to 60 panels and ex-GST) + mounting installation labour (QV AKL roofer + labourer hourly rates x assumed 20-36 crew hours) + supplementary purlins (QV proprietary purlin supply-and-fix rate x assumed 35-58 m for one third of the 120 m2 footprint) + purlin bolts (QV bolt rate, bolts excluded from the purlin row) + cleats/sundries allowance + engineer's wind/uplift design and PS1 (engineer fee schedule). Scope follows the brief exactly: excludes PV modules, inverters, cabling/electrical, roof works, scaffolding/edge protection/access, and consent fees; no preliminaries, margin or GST. Confidence is LOW because the mounting system is a residential web proxy (QV publishes nothing for solar mounting), and the labour hours, purlin length and bolt counts are QS assumptions. Allowances carry well under a third of the total, but the largest component rests on a proxy. Round each sub-part separately: mounting~$5,310-$10,380; strengthening~$1,940-$4,300; design~$1,900-$4,000.

band.unit: sum (whole array - 30 kWp / ~60 panels / ~120 m2, Auckland, GST exclusive)
band.basis: Lump sum for the array-support scope only: proprietary rails/clamps/brackets/fixings + mounting labour + supplementary purlins to one third of footprint + PS1/wind design. Excludes everything on the excluded list (PV modules, inverters, cabling/electrical, roof works, scaffolding/access, prelims, margin, GST, consent fees). Sum of five components: 3,500-8,000 mounting hardware (web proxy) + 3,600-9,600 mounting labour (allowance) + 1,000-1,950 purlins (QV) + 150-400 bolts (allowance) + 600-1,800 design/PS1 (QV % proxy). CAUTION: allowances/fee proxies carry ~45% of the band, so confidence is low and the band should be read as a cost-plan range, not a price. Biggest single uncertainty is the mounting supply-and-fix rate; get one installer quote to firm it.
